definition: A state or occupier takes over private aircraft, railways or vehicles for war use and bars civilians from them.

name: Exodus of the wealthy after social upheaval
definition: Wealthy people, aristocrats or other classes emigrate or flee the cities en masse as socialist rule or social revolution destroys their position.

name: Treaty banning or limiting a class of weapons in war
definition: Powers agree by treaty or international law to ban or limit classes of weapons (atomic bombs, aircraft, submarines, post-1900 arms, arms in space) and to fight only with the allowed ones.
aliases: ban on atomic bombs in war

name: Offense-defense arms race in new weapons
definition: Every new superweapon is soon copied or answered by an enemy countermeasure or worse weapon, so that new arms escalate competition instead of securing peace.

name: Welfare state
definition: A government provides citizens with pensions, unemployment support, relief for the poor, child and mother support and a minimum standard of living as a standing legal entitlement.
aliases: Socialist state supporting all its citizens
State welfare and support for children and mothers
bundle_check: pensions, unemployment relief and child support kept together as one statutory welfare system

name: Wholesale replanning of cities
definition: Existing large cities are demolished or rebuilt on new planned, uniform lines, after destruction or by policy.

name: Region-wide electric power failure
definition: The electric supply fails across a city or region at once, stopping lighting, transport and water for days and sometimes forcing a return to wood fires and horse transport.

name: Wish-fulfilling tree or cow
definition: A tree, cow or river in heaven yields whatever its owner wishes.

name: Work as voluntary creative pleasure
definition: Labor is freed from drudgery and wage compulsion and done as pleasurable craft, creative expression or free choice of occupation.

name: Cooperative and worker ownership of enterprises
definition: Workers, communities or religious bodies own and run stores, farms and firms cooperatively, with employees sharing ownership and management.
aliases: Workers share ownership and management of firms
bundle_check: ownership, profit sharing and cooperatives kept together as one worker-capital arrangement

name: Employer enforcement of social conformity
definition: Companies manage employees' private lives, moods or aptitude and rank them by sociability to enforce conformity and suppress dissent.

name: Daylight blotted out across the world
definition: The sun is darkened or hidden for days over the world or a large region by ash, cloud or a cosmic cause.

name: World domination through air power
definition: A nation, secret group or monopoly rules the world by mastery of the air, with airship or aircraft fleets deciding wars and subjecting humanity.

name: Fire that consumes the world
definition: The whole Earth, or the whole cosmos at the end of an age, is burned up in a universal fire sent by a god, a star or a cosmic cycle, so that all land, sea and living things are destroyed.

name: Peace imposed by a superweapon holder
definition: One person, small group or power holding an overwhelming secret weapon forces the great powers to stop fighting a war and disarm.
aliases: scientist destroys warships to end war

name: Blight destroys the world's crops
definition: A disease, pest or soil blight attacks wheat, rice and other food crops across many countries, causing global food shortage.

name: Worldwide free trade
definition: Tariffs and customs duties are abolished among nearly all nations so that goods move without barriers.

name: Violent youth gangs
definition: Organized gangs of young people terrorize cities with fights, vehicles and violence.
